Idrakpur Fort

ইদ্রাকপুর দুর্গ

A riverside defence built in Mughal Bengal, with a distinctive raised circular platform.

Plan your visit

Location
Munshiganj Sadar, Munshiganj
How to get there
Start in Munshiganj town near the old court. If coming by road through Muktarpur, continue by rickshaw or auto-rickshaw to the fort.
Access and opening hours
The Tourism Board lists the fort, but current gate hours and interior access could not be verified. Ask locally before travelling.
Bangladesh Tourism Board · Idrakpur Fort

Published sources reviewed 20 November 2026.

Mughal Bengal · 1660

About this place

The Bangladesh Tourism Board dates the fort to 1660 and credits it to Mir Jumla. It formed part of the effort to protect waterways leading toward Dhaka from raids. Brick perimeter walls and the elevated circular structure make the plan easy to read from ground level. Compare it with the river forts of Narayanganj to understand how the Mughals defended several approaches to the capital.

Find it near the old court area in Munshiganj town. Confirm access before travelling and stay off restricted walls and brickwork.
